 Home > SERP APIs > VALUE SERP API 
 Get real-time and reliable search data from the world’s best value SERP API – VALUE SERP 
 Clean data with no manual rules or web-scraper maintenance 
 Scalable and adaptable to work with your apps and projects 
 Pay as you go from just $2.50/1k searches 
 Try for free 
 No credit card required 
 Why Choose VALUE SERP API? 
 Get all of the Google search results data you need reliably from a trusted partner. 
 Simple Requests in Formats You Choose 
 Collecting data is as easy as performing a GET HTTP request. With your provided parameters, VALUE SERP executes searches in real time and returns clean data in JSON, HTML, or CSV formats. 
 Location and Device-Specific Data 
 Using the VALUE SERP Locations API to search for VALUE SERP-supported Google search locations to add to your requests, and even filter to a specific device type. Get localized and targeted results so you can focus your efforts where it counts. 
 Data Auto-Delivered to You 
 Destinations allow you to send Batch results to destinations you define: Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, Microsoft Azure Blob Storage, Alibaba Cloud OSS or any other S3-compatible object storage. 
 Quickly Collect and Store Large Groups of Data 
 Looking to gather data in bulk? Schedule up to 15,000 requests and get results returned in a few minutes with Batches on VALUE SERP. Schedule Batches to run monthly, weekly, daily, hourly, or manually on demand – you’re in control. 
 Cost-Effective Solutions 
 Flexible plans and pricing that’s meant for scale. With a per-request rate as low as $0.50 per 1K searches, VALUE SERP keeps your budget in mind.

 Additional Features & Benefits 
 Advanced Rendering & Parsing 
 VALUE SERP renders requests in a full-in memory browser and parses search engine result pages without the need for manual rules that break when layouts change. 
 Image Extraction 
 Base64-encoded or deferred-load images are no problem – VALUE SERP gets all images for every section of the page – place images, inline images, video thumbnails, knowledge graph images. 
 Multi-step Downloading 
 VALUE SERP has the ability to make multiple subsequent requests in order to get data from pages linked from the initial SERP page – no additional cost to you. 
 Ease of Integration 
 VALUE SERP offers intuitive and developer-friendly APIs, making integration a breeze for both novice and experienced users. 
 Reliable Performance 
 With VALUE SERP, you can count on reliable performance and uptime with minimum maintenance required. 
 Comprehensive Documentation 
 Access comprehensive documentation and support resources to facilitate smooth integration and troubleshooting. 
 Scalability 
 VALUE SERP is designed to grow with your needs, allowing you to scale your usage as your projects and applications expand. 
 Cost-Effective Solutions 
 VALUE SERP offers flexible pricing plans to suit businesses of all sizes, ensuring you get the most value out of your investment.
